name: imu_calibrate_reconnect
description: Calibrate IMU when the link drops mid-write: the same hands-free scene as imu_calibrate, but the first set_sensor_mount fails as a dropped socket would. The screen must keep the solve PENDING for this device (and say it will be sent on reconnect); then the journey drops the real socket, the client reconnects on its own, and the connection manager's onConnected pushes the pending calibration and clears it once the read-back matches.

steps.description: open Calibrate IMU with the first mount write failing
three poses, solve, the write fails -> pending on this phone
drop the socket; the client reconnects by itself
the reconnect pushes the pending calibration and confirms it
